text:
anna: FYI new onboarding run hit a mypy/pyright issue with the `@retry` decorator on AsyncClient RPCs. The decorator strips coroutine return types so wrapped methods show up as `Callable[..., Any]` in stubs and editors.

ben: Ugh. Minimal repro?

anna: Paste: (mypy 1.9.0)

```py
from redwood import AsyncClient, retry
client = AsyncClient(api_key='x')

@retry(max_tries=3)
async def get_user(uid: str) -> dict:
    return await client.users.get(uid)

# later
user = await get_user('u1')
print(user['id'])  # mypy: "'Any' has no attribute '__getitem__'"
```

olga: The decorator in our runtime is generic but the pyi generator emits an untyped `Callable` for decorated functions. We should preserve exact call signature & return type in stubs, e.g., using typing.ParamSpec and typing.Concatenate or `typing_extensions` ParamSpec to forward the signature.

ben: Good plan. Is there a quick fix that doesn't require changing user code?

olga: Two options: 1) update the retry decorator's stub to be a generic decorator factory that returns a Callable[[P], Coroutine[Any, Any, R]] when given an async function (needs ParamSpec + TypeVar R). 2) Add `@typing.experimental` helpers is ugly. Option 1 is the right long-term fix and is non-breaking for runtime.

anna: Also pyright flagged that PyCharm/VSCode show no completions after decoration. So editors lose return type info. Fixing stubs will help.

ben: Can we detect sync vs async functions in the decorator and generate two overloads in the pyi? That might play nicer with older type checkers that lack ParamSpec.

olga: Yes: emit two overloads: one for sync callables and one for async that preserves the returning Awaitable[T]. We'll add a fallback Any version for older checkers. Also include a small sampleapp mypy test.

anna: Please add a short doc snippet explaining how to type custom decorators when extending SDK; new hires were confused.

olga: I'll open an issue and a small PR: pyi change + tests + docs. Will assign to devex and eng-ml for autogen template touch.

anna: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3250 — reproducer + suggested pyi overloads.

devx-bot: Issue created: #3250 by @anna — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3250 :white_check_mark:

ben: Thanks. Can we backport to the branch used by onboarding images? New hires are pinned to that release.

olga: Will include backport plan in PR description.

anna: Great, this will clear a blocker for strict typing dev flows.
